title: Merle Ambrose offers a new wizard Unicorn Way, WC-COMMONS-MAIN-001; ACCEPT sends the wizard to Unicorn Way, where the quest's Start dialog plays
notes: The new-player start: Merle Ambrose, template 38168 (WC-HUB-NPC01), offers WC-COMMONS-MAIN-001 with its three Prep lines, and To Ravenwood! (WC-MAIN-C01-001) waits for it,
as authored in data/sql/updates/db_world/2026_10_14_12.sql. ACCEPT runs the quest's start ResTeleport, which asks the client to leave for
WizardCity/WC_Streets/WC_Unicorn, and the quest's Start dialog, Ambrose's farewell and Gamma pointing at Private Connelly, plays once the wizard stands there.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: make the main account a game master
the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
log in
the server accepts the password
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
the game server puts the wizard in Merle Ambrose's house
steps.pattern: put wizard {wizard_guid} in WizardCity/Interiors/WC_Headmistress_House instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.name: the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard stands 200 units from Merle Ambrose, facing him
the camera settles by Merle Ambrose
the wizard takes a step toward Merle Ambrose
walking up to Merle Ambrose offers WC-COMMONS-MAIN-001
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} entered the service range of NPC \d+ \(template (\d+), mobile id \d+, \S+ with icon \S+\) and was shown 1 option

steps.name: the prompt of Merle Ambrose
press X, as the prompt asks
the server offers WC-COMMONS-MAIN-001
the first Prep line
MORE shows the second Prep line
the second Prep line
MORE shows the third Prep line beside the offer window
the third Prep line and the offer window
ACCEPT takes the quest

until.pattern: asked its client to leave \S+ for (\S+)

steps.name: the quest is accepted after its start results send the wizard toward Unicorn Way
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} accepted quest (\S+) from NPC \d+ with 1 start goal

steps.name: the client loads Unicorn Way and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the quest's Start dialog plays where the wizard arrives
steps.pattern: wizard {wizard_guid} arrived in \S+ where quest (\S+) sent it and was shown its Start dialog

steps.name: Ambrose's farewell on arrival
MORE shows Gamma's line
Gamma points at Private Connelly
